headline: Canadian hip-hop artist runs length of Yonge Street for homelessness
meta_description: A Canadian hip-hop artist is running the full length of Yonge Street to raise funds and awareness for homelessness.
summary_short: A Canadian hip-hop artist is running the entire length of Yonge Street to raise funds and awareness for homelessness.
body:
A Canadian hip-hop artist is running the full length of Yonge Street to raise funds and awareness for homelessness. The ambitious effort combines athletic endurance with activism, turning one of Canada's most iconic streets into a platform for social change.

The run along Yonge Street represents both a personal physical challenge and a public statement about housing insecurity. By choosing such a visible, well-known route, the artist is bringing homelessness awareness directly to the communities and audiences who travel this landmark thoroughfare daily.

Through this initiative, the artist aims to generate both financial support for homelessness services and broader public conversation about the issue. The project demonstrates how creative individuals in the hip-hop community are using their platforms and talents to address pressing social concerns.
